description: Source code for executing API requests in a Google Workspace CLI, including request building, response handling, pagination, error processing, and schema validation.

classes.name: AuthMethod
classes.description: Enum tracking the authentication method used for requests.

classes.name: PaginationConfig
classes.description: Configuration for auto-pagination, with default implementation.

methods.name: parse_and_validate_inputs
methods.description: Parses parameters and body JSON, validates against schema, checks required parameters, and builds request URL.

methods.name: build_http_request
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP request with proper method, auth, query params, headers, and body, including multipart upload handling.

methods.name: handle_json_response
methods.description: Processes JSON responses, handles pagination, sanitization, and output formatting.

methods.name: handle_binary_response
methods.description: Streams binary responses to a file and returns metadata or outputs it.

methods.name: execute_method
methods.description: Main function to execute an API method call, handling request building, response processing, pagination, and errors.

methods.name: build_url
methods.description: Constructs the full request URL from the discovery document, method, and parameters, including handling uploads.

methods.name: extract_template_path_parameters
methods.description: Extracts path parameter names from a URL template.

methods.name: render_path_template
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in URL templates with encoded parameter values.

methods.name: extract_enable_url
methods.description: Extracts a GCP console enable URL from an accessNotConfigured error message.

methods.name: handle_error_response
methods.description: Parses error responses, including API errors and access issues, and returns appropriate GwsError.

methods.name: build_multipart_body
methods.description: Creates multipart/related body for media uploads, with proper boundary and headers.

methods.name: validate_body_against_schema
methods.description: Validates a JSON body against a schema defined in the discovery document.

methods.name: validate_value
methods.description: Recursively validates a JSON value against a schema, checking types, enums, and references.

methods.name: validate_properties
methods.description: Validates object properties against schema properties and required fields.

methods.name: validate_property
methods.description: Validates a single property value against its schema definition.

methods.name: get_value_type
methods.description: Returns a string describing the JSON value type.

methods.name: mime_to_extension
methods.description: Maps MIME types to file extensions.
